title: World Feud
tagline: World Feud is a groundbreaking social strategy game that merges the excitement of competition with the transformative power of sentiment analytics.
description:
The game envisions a future where collective sentiment guides smarter decisions. Players must navigate dynamic scenarios using advanced sentiment analysis, balancing diverse perspectives to foster social consensus. From mediating political disputes to shaping cultural movements, every decision impacts the game world, echoing the complex interplay of real-world dynamics.

World Feud is more than a game—it’s a call to action, inspiring players to think critically, empathize, and innovate solutions that transcend borders and ideologies. Join the feud, and shape the world!
how_its_made:
1.	World MiniKit Integration
I leveraged the World MiniKit as the backbone of our game’s infrastructure. 

2.	World ID Integration
For secure and decentralized user identification, I integrated World ID.

3. Framework: Next.js
For the frontend and backend, I chose Next.js due to its versatility and robust feature set.

4. Hacky Integration of Sentiment Data into Gameplay:
I implemented a real-time feedback loop translating sentiment data into live in-game consequences.

5.	Supabase Connection
I connected the app to Supabase for database management and real-time capabilities, enabling seamless storage and retrieval of game data with minimal backend overhead.

6. Custom Component Library for Native Mobile UX/UI
To ensure a polished and intuitive mobile experience, I designed and utilized a custom component library tailored for native mobile UX/UI.
